How It Works

Three ideas that make
Moodfilm different.

Feature 01

It listens
before it recommends.

Most apps ask you to pick a genre. Moodfilm asks how you're actually feeling — and means it. You type freely, like you're texting a friend, and the app reads between the lines.

  • Understands natural language — "I'm exhausted but can't sleep and feeling restless" is a valid input.
  • Detects emotional intensity: a mild Tuesday sadness and a post-breakup low are treated differently.
  • Identifies what you need from a film tonight — escape, catharsis, laughter, inspiration — even if you don't spell it out.
  • Remembers your intent across the session so picks stay coherent, not random.

"I'm tired but not sleepy. Had a weird week. I just want something that reminds me the world is still kind of beautiful."

Reading your mood…
Feature 02

The app feels
what you feel.

Moodfilm's Theme Engine shifts the entire visual atmosphere of the app in real time as your mood is detected. It's not a gimmick — it's a signal that the app is genuinely paying attention.

  • Each emotional state maps to a distinct colour palette — deep indigo for loneliness, warm amber for nostalgia, electric violet for inspiration.
  • The background, glows, and accents shift fluidly. You feel the change more than you see it.
  • Designed for OLED screens — rich, deep tones that are cinematic, not clinical.
  • Zero input required. The engine reads your typed mood and responds automatically.
😔 Lonely → deep violet
😤 Angry → dark ember
🥹 Nostalgic → amber gold
✨ Inspired → electric indigo
☕ Cozy → warm hearth
Feature 03

One perfect pick.
Not a ranked list.

Every search surfaces a single Hero Pick — the film with the highest emotional resonance for your exact mood and intent — alongside a mood-match score and a personal explanation written just for you, right now.

  • A mood-match score from 0–100 tells you how closely the film aligns with your current state.
  • A short, personal explanation speaks directly to your emotional context — not a generic synopsis.
  • A 6–8 word poetic tagline for each recommendation you can actually feel.
  • Five additional picks by genre follow — each curated for your mood, not just popularity.

Feature 04

Genre picks that
actually understand you.

After your Hero Pick, Moodfilm surfaces five more films — one per genre — each individually matched to your mood, not just popular titles slotted into boxes. The genre is a lens, not a filter.

  • Genres are dynamically weighted by your emotional state — "anxious" raises Drama and gentle Comedy, avoids Horror.
  • Preference for Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Korean, or English is respected in every single pick.
  • Rare and less-obvious films are intentionally surfaced alongside known titles — no endless blockbusters.
  • Each genre card has its own explanation, match score, and OTT availability so you can watch right now.

The Experience

See it in motion.

01 / 06
The Splash
A cinematic opening — no onboarding, no instructions. Just the logo, the tagline, and the mood canvas waking up behind it.
Under the Hood

Built quietly.
Works beautifully.

We don't talk much about what's powering Moodfilm — but here's a plain-English look at the ideas that make it work.

🧠
Two Minds Working in Relay
Your mood passes through two AI models, not one. A fast model reads what you typed the instant you hit send — sensing emotion, intensity, and what you actually need tonight. A deeper model then composes the picks, scores how closely each film matches, and writes the reason behind every choice.
Two-Stage AI
🎬
A Window Into Every Film
Posters, ratings, runtimes, genres, and where each title is streaming in your country come from a vast global film catalogue — Hollywood to Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, and Korean cinema alike — so a recommendation is never just a name, it's something you can watch right now.
Global Film Data
⚡
A Backend With No Back
There's no server sitting in one city. The whole engine — the AI pipeline, the film lookups, your session — runs on a network of edge nodes spread worldwide, executing from wherever you happen to be. No cold starts, no spinning wheel.
Serverless Edge
🗄️
Memory That Lives at the Edge
Your credits, your subscription, your free-trial status — all kept in a lightweight store that travels on the same edge network as everything else. Purchases still being confirmed wait safely in their own separate space until they clear.
Edge Key-Value Store
💳
Pay Without Leaving the Moment
Top up a handful of credits or unlock a monthly pass right inside the app — no card forms, no redirect to a checkout page. Billing happens natively through your device, so the only thing between you and a film is a single tap.
In-App Billing
🔔
Purchases That Land Instantly
The second a payment clears, a real-time event is pushed straight to the backend and your credits appear — no refresh, no "please wait while we verify." Behind the scenes a notification stream keeps the app and the store perfectly in sync.
Live Purchase Events
📱
A Website That Behaves Like an App
Moodfilm installs from the browser, sits on your home screen, opens full-screen, works offline for the core experience, and updates itself silently in the background. It even ships in the app store as a real, installable Android app — same code, no rewrite.
Progressive Web App
🔐
Identity Without a Sign-Up
No account, no email, no password — ever. Your credits and preferences are quietly tied to your device, so the app remembers you across visits without you ever having to tell it who you are.
Passwordless
🎨
A Mood You Can See
Every colour, glow, and gradient on screen is driven by a handful of live style variables that the app rewrites in real time from your detected mood. No images, no heavy graphics — just type, paired serif and sans fonts, and the browser doing what it's quietly brilliant at.
CSS Theme Engine
